name: Citadel Apex
title: Citadel Apex
summary: The Citadel Apex is the main tower of Gaerlan's Citadel that broke off when the citadel crashed and now sits on a peak overlooking Citadel Valley; Martine's mask and robe still lie inside where the Ispar portal once was. In the kit it is a 66 m green-glass sculpture-tower (0x01002B05, 23 m square, base z 345, top 410.8) on a snowy mountain top, the crashed citadel 285 m below to the north-east.

landmarks.name: Apex tower
landmarks.note: 0x01002B05, top z 410.8; Martine's Robe and Mask at z 382.7 inside.

insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (chapter ch1).

shots.standingOrder: Climb a 47 deg clockwise corkscrew round Gaerlan's broken tower, radius 42 m to 52 m and 28 m to 58 m above its base, keeping the whole tower in frame; nothing within 40 m, open air over the south slope.
shots.notes: Hero helix on the Citadel Apex: the 66 m green-glass main tower of Gaerlan's Citadel that snapped off and landed on a peak above Citadel Valley. The climb starts below its crown with the mountain falling away and ends above it looking down on the tower, the valley far below. Noon sun high in the south behind the camera. shots.standingOrder: Fly north-north-east 19 m above the tower top at 5 m/s, gimbal tracking it through straight down with a slow yaw slew; nothing within 19 m of the lens.
shots.notes: Overhead pass: the glass crown of the Apex slides beneath the lens and the gimbal follows it through nadir, revealing the drop to Citadel Valley 285 m below on the far side.
